name: Dice Games raises Wild Strike's crit-chance modifier by 10 (#3209)
contract: 801438 'Dice Games' reads 'Increases the critical strike chance of Wild Strike and Assault by $s1%.' It is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, BasePoints 9+1=10, class mask (0, 33024, 0) = word1 bits {8, 15}. Wild Strike 501724 has SpellFamilyFlags (0, 256, 524288) = word1 bit 8, a direct match; the 'Assault' half of the mask (word1 bit 15) is not independently confirmed here, but Wild Strike alone already proves the native delivery this issue disputes. Unit::SpellCriticalBonus (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp) calls ApplySpellMod(spellProto->Id, SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, crit_chance) unconditionally, so no script is needed.

steps.label: CONTRACT: Wild Strike's crit-chance modifier rises by 10
